title: Classify deliberately-standalone reference tables + add de-flatten / completeness re-freeze gates
description: Final eshyra-o9bd.8 slice. Classify the genuinely owner-less reference tables (celtic/egyptian/greek/norse deities, standard/exotic languages, standard-exchange-rates, difficulty-classes, experience-points/proficiency-bonus by CR, hit-dice-by-size, size-categories, damage-severity-by-level, trap-save-dcs, travel-pace, donning-and-doffing-armor) as deliberately standalone with a documented allowlist. Add the two o9bd.8 re-freeze gates: (1) table-link completeness — every non-allowlisted table is reachable from an owner; (2) no duplicate table linearization in primary prose unless under a deliberate sourceText field. Close out eshyra-o9bd.8.
design: Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. The completeness gate consumes the owner map (8.1/8.2) + standalone allowlist. De-flatten appears already satisfied; gate guards against regression. Add per-child thaw note + refresh freeze-manifest hashes.
